_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

holy-heal.purpose: Raid healer: Flash Heal / Greater Heal downranked, Renew, Prayer of Healing; mana over 5+ minutes, Inspiration on tanks.
loop: Greater Heal / Flash Heal by damage
Prayer of Healing on raid damage
Inner Focus for a free Greater Heal
constraints: Discipline tier 1 has only Unbreakable Will or Wand Specialization: healers take Unbreakable Will for stun/fear resists
threat: Silent Resolve is taken by healers who over-heal on pulls

Unbreakable Will.why: Tier-1 Discipline filler with a use (stun/fear resist); Wand Specialization does nothing for a healer.

Silent Resolve.why: -4%/rank spell threat: healers pulling aggro on pulls.

Holy Specialization.why: Crit heals; 'Inspiration... provides your tanks with a lot of extra mitigation when your direct healing spells critically heal them'.

Mental Agility.why: Cheaper instants (Renew, Shield): part of the mana budget.

Inner Focus.why: 'Adds a lot of efficiency to your healing ability every 3 minutes.'

Spiritual Healing.why: 'Provides you with a flat 10% healing increase.'

shadow-dps.purpose: Leveling: Shadow Word: Pain, Mind Blast, Mind Flay kiting, wand finish; Spirit Tap for mana; Blackout stuns and Shield for safety.
constraints: Blackout stuns are survivability while leveling (nothing on bosses)
Shadow Focus removes resists on the DoT; Shadow Reach is one more cast before melee

Blackout.why: 10% stun chance per Shadow spell: interrupts the mob while it walks to you.

Improved Power Word: Shield.encoded: heal on the shield + surv 1%/rank leveling

Shadow Focus.why: Resisted Shadow Word: Pain / Mind Flay means taking hits.

Shadow Reach.why: +20% range: one more cast before melee.

Unbreakable Will.why: Discipline tier-1 path to Inner Focus/Meditation.

Mind Flay.why: The channelled filler of the shadow loop: 47% of a shadow priest's raid damage in the simulator. The model carries it as a gated source (2026-09-26) whose share goes to wanding and Smite when the talent is absent; the leveling split comes from the fight lab.

Improved Vampiric Embrace.why: +5%/rank Vampiric Embrace self-healing (Classic): less eating between leveling fights.

Martyrdom.why: Pushback immunity after being crit (beta): a leveling safety point of the leveling build; nothing in a raid.

Spirit Tap.why: +100% Spirit for 15 s after a kill with 50% regen while casting (beta): the leveling mana loop; nothing in a raid, where nothing dies.

Silence.why: 5 s silence and a 3 s interrupt (beta): the leveling answer to caster mobs (the fight lab's interrupt); raid utility only.

Improved Shadow Word: Pain.why: +3 s (one tick) per rank on Shadow Word: Pain, the dot that opens every pull; the fight lab values it 0.27%/point because mobs die before the extra ticks land.

Shadow Weaving.why: +3%/rank shadow damage taken after each shadow spell, stacking to five: the raid's shadow debuff; while leveling it only builds over the first casts of a pull (0.33%/point), and it is the path to Vampiric Embrace and Shadowform.

Improved Mind Blast.why: -0.5 s/rank Mind Blast cooldown: more Mind Blasts per fight; 0.39%/point in the fight lab, just under the audit threshold.
